```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| label: eotplot
// https://observablehq.com/@mcmcclur/plot-for-mathematicians
{
  await whenVisible("eotplot");
  let w = 800;
  let h = 0.625 * w;
  let samples = build_samples(
    getEot, -365, 365, { N: 150 }
  );
  let plot = Plot.plot({
    ariaDescription: "Line chart of the equation of time in millidays over a common year followed by a leap year, ranging from about -9.8 to 11.4 millidays",
    marginLeft: 60,
    width: w,
    height: h,
    style: "font-size:19;",
    y: {label: "Equation of time (md)"},
    x: {label: "Day of year"},
    marks: [
      Plot.line(samples, {
        strokeWidth: 4,
        stroke: "steelblue",
        tip: true
      }),
      Plot.ruleX([-365]),
      Plot.ruleY([0]),
      Plot.axisX({ y: 0 }),
      Plot.axisY({ x: -365 })
    ]
  });
  return plot;
}
```
